purpose: Contract C rule R11 is the ONLY path to indexation for a non-factual institutional page (home, methodology, navigation). A Gate 12-I PASS is necessary but never sufficient. A certification records governance=governed, validation=validated, release=authorized, and that the page asserts no factual claim. Only status 'certified' entries are used. For organizational publishers, certified_by identifies the responsible publisher organization for nonfactual editorial content, not a human scientific peer reviewer. Gate 12-I and publication-authority surface checks remain separate mandatory vetoes.

Owner-confirmed publisher identity. This certification applies only to the EN/DE institutional homepages.
